players.product: Carbonate fuel-cell power plants (FuelCell Energy Blocks) for behind-the-meter baseload data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's 10-K: fiscal 2025 (year ended October 31, 2025) total revenues were $158,162 thousand versus $112,132 thousand (+41%): product $69,129 thousand (+169%), service agreements $20,398 thousand (+105%), generation $48,013 thousand (-4%), Advanced Technologies $20,622 thousand (-22%). Gross loss $(26,408) thousand; gross margin (16.7)% versus (32.0)%.

FuelCell Energy's 10-K: top customers accounted for 82% of total revenue in fiscal 2025 (68% in fiscal 2024, 75% in fiscal 2023). XBRL fiscal 2025 shares: Gyeonggi Green Energy Co., Ltd. (GGE, South Korea) 46% (18% in fiscal 2024), United Illuminating 7%, ExxonMobil Technology and Engineering Company (EMTEC) 6%, Esso Nederland B.V. 5%, Ameresco/Sacramento Sewer 2%, Korea Southern Power Company (KOSPO) 1%.
quarterly_data.figure: top customers 82% of FY2025 revenue; GGE 46%

quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's 10-K: backlog rose approximately 2.6% to $1.19 billion as of October 31, 2025 from $1.16 billion, primarily from the Hartford Project and the CGN LTSA: service agreements $162.4 million (from $174.2 million), generation $945.2 million (from $841.4 million), product backlog 'totaled $66.2 as of October 31, 2025' as filed (from $111.3 million), Advanced Technologies $19.5 million (from $36.0 million). The service and generation portion had a weighted average term of approximately 15 years.

FuelCell Energy's 10-K: annualized production rate was 31.5 MW in fiscal 2025 versus approximately 27.7 MW in fiscal 2024, from higher production at the Torrington facility based on contracted demand. Property, plant and equipment spending was expected at $20.0 million-$30.0 million for fiscal 2026 as FuelCell increases carbonate manufacturing capacity for certain processes at Torrington 'to prepare for expected demand from the growing data center market'. Under its 2024-2025 restructurings FuelCell ceased its manufacturing capacity expansion in Calgary, Canada and development of its solid oxide power generation platform to refocus on core carbonate technologies.
quarterly_data.figure: annualized production 31.5 MW (FY2025) vs ~27.7 MW; FY2026 PP&E $20.0-$30.0 million

quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's 10-K: FuelCell designs and manufactures the core fuel cell components; four fuel cell stacks are combined into a 1.25 MW power block (module), and balance-of-plant (BOP) components are either purchased directly from suppliers or their manufacturing is outsourced to FuelCell's designs, then shipped to the project site for assembly. Key raw materials include nickel and stainless steel; some key components have a limited number of suppliers. Carbonate systems reach up to 50% initial electrical efficiency (47% average) and combined heat and power efficiencies up to 80%.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.25 MW module = four stacks; up to 50% electrical efficiency

quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's 10-K: under the GGE LTSA (58.8 MW GGE Platform, Hwaseong-si, South Korea) six 1.4-MW replacement modules were commissioned in Q4 fiscal 2024 and 22 in fiscal 2025, with the remaining 14 expected in fiscal 2026. A July 30, 2025 LTSA with CGN-Yulchon Generation Co., Ltd. covers eight replacement carbonate fuel cell modules, balance-of-plant replacement components and long-term service for $31.7 million ($24.0 million added to product backlog).
quarterly_data.figure: GGE: 22 modules commissioned in FY2025, 14 remaining; CGN LTSA $31.7 million

connects_to.relationship: Electricity sold to Eversource under power purchase agreements from FuelCell-owned fuel cell plants in Connecticut

contracts.signal: FuelCell Energy's 10-K (XBRL): Connecticut Light And Power accounted for 15% of revenue in fiscal 2025 (November 1, 2024 - October 31, 2025), 21% in fiscal 2024 and 13% in fiscal 2023. The 10-K names The Connecticut Light and Power Company d/b/a Eversource Energy (CLPC), which agreed under an Amended and Restated PPA of October 19, 2018 to purchase all electricity output of the Derby Projects (14.0 MW Derby CT RFP-2 and 2.8 MW SCEF Derby, 20-year PPAs, off-taker listed as Eversource/United Illuminating); Connecticut Light and Power is also the off-taker of the 14.9 MW Bridgeport Fuel Cell Project (15-year PPA).

In January 2025 FuelCell Energy entered into a 20-year PPA with Eversource and United Illuminating under which it will build and operate a 7.4 MW carbonate fuel cell power plant in Hartford, Connecticut (the Hartford Project) and sell the electricity to Eversource and United Illuminating; revenue over the term is expected to total approximately $167.4 million, added to generation backlog. The 10-K states an expectation of completing construction in calendar 2026 and commencing commercial operations in December 2026, and elsewhere expects completion by the end of calendar 2027, paced by the electrical interconnection with the utility, with approximately $34.0 million to $36.0 million of remaining project investment.
